同一个问题，只差「有没有人把这一段交下来」。: Same question; the only difference is whether anyone handed this stretch over.

新接手的 agent 不用你讲，翻一眼就接上了； 哪一步是谁做的、为什么改，也都: The agent taking over does not need your briefing; one look and it continues. Who did which step, and why it changed, still hang off the record.
全貌怎么拼出来的：事件线 + 小本本: How the whole picture gets assembled: timeline + notebook
事件线记「发生了什么、为什么改」；小本本记「整体是什么、这一步在干什么」。 两边: The timeline records what happened and why it changed; the notebook records what the whole thing is and what this step is doing. Read the two side by side and you see the whole picture without losing the current step, so drift is harder.

改成先切分支再合。旧结论标成「被取代」，没删。: Branch first, then merge. The old conclusion is marked "superseded", not deleted.
交接条写下停在哪、下一步归谁，新 agent 接着做。: The handoff note records where it stopped and who owns the next step; the new agent continues.
你问「当初为什么不动 main」，它翻出第 5 天那句原话。: You ask why main was left alone, and it pulls up the exact sentence from Day 5.

main 别直接推，先切分支。: No direct pushes to main; branch first.
小本本只增不改：改主意是加一条，不是把上一条抹掉。: The notebook is append-only: a change of mind adds a line, it does not erase the previous one.
点四个时刻，看每次回头它能不能接上。案例仅作示范，机制按真实实现绘制。: Click the four moments to see whether each look back picks up the thread. The case is illustrative; the mechanics follow the real implementation.
能核对是下限，也是上限。: Being checkable is the floor and the ceiling.
不替你判断对错: It does not judge right or wrong for you
只保证每条结论能追到原话和出处；采信哪条，还是人说了算。: It only guarantees that every conclusion traces back to the exact words and their provenance; which one to trust is still a human call.
不把推断当事实: It does not treat inference as fact
因果、意图这类推断会标出来，不和「已发生」混在一张卡里。: Inferences about causality or intent are marked, never mixed with what happened on the same card.
不共享别人的环境: It does not share another person's environment
主机、账号、品牌按 agent 隔离；同一主人名下的记忆才互通。: Host, account and brand are isolated per agent; only memories under the same owner are shared.
不静默丢: It does not drop things silently
隔离、省略、截断都要有计数；「没有」和「没找到」分开说。: Isolation, omission and truncation are all counted; none and not found are reported separately.
